缺陷后果：越想立刻赢，越把路径弄复杂
机灵：不是硬破坏，而是故意制造错误方向
行动力：变招仍然通过身体和机械尾巴完成
记忆点：长机械龙尾既是受限部位，也是最后的反制工具

长机械龙尾全程清楚并参与动态链
机械龙爪脚与两片头盔卡扣可见

negative_prompt: no ordinary fantasy dragon, no character redesign, no extra wings, no extra weapons, no new costume, no subtitles, no logo, no readable or random text, no tail disappearance, no muddy silhouette, no abstract effect replacing the action
h3_prompt: Anime cinematic MV animation, clean readable 2D shapes, keep the established Lillong character identity, original face and proportions, two-piece helmet clips, mechanical dragon-claw feet, and a long segmented mechanical dragon tail with visible upper, middle, and lower rhythm. Warm sky above a cold blue lake in a layered forest. Show the dynamic chain visually: she rushes forward to win, repeated mechanical paths and forest structures predict and push her back, she is forced to break the obstacle into local rhythms, then uses a deliberately wrong direction, a reverse tail swing, and the lake reflection to create a false path and escape from the side. End with her landing at the cold lake edge as the warm sky, forest opening, and tail line reorganize the space. Low-angle close-up, repeated lateral tracking, top-down decomposition, sudden reverse orbit, final pullback. Character charm comes from wanting to win too quickly, making the situation more complicated, then solving it with an unexpected clever move. No text, no logo, no subtitles, no ordinary dragon redesign, no extra wings or weapons.
